265:   .mtd-quiz-intro {
266:     padding-top: 24px;
267:   }
268: 
269:   .mtd-quiz-intro-card {
270:     grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
271:     gap: 24px;
272:     padding: 24px;
273:   }
274: 
275:   .mtd-hero-ctas {
276:     gap: 8px;
277:   }
278: }
279: 
280: /* Variant A's dialog matches Figma 3776:6405 (panel 1520 × ~597 at 200,242 on
281:    a 1920 canvas): black fill, 1px #474747 border, 40px radius, 40px padding,
282:    backdrop near-black, and a 24px X in the top-right corner. The only close
283:    control is that real <button> — no head/foot chrome. Scoped to the generated
284:    page so the registered page keeps its approved 1200 shell. */
285: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-backdrop {
286:   background: #000;
287: }
288: 
289: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-panel {
290:   width: min(1520px, 100%);
291:   max-height: calc(100vh - 48px);
292:   /* The dialog hugs its content: the iframe is fitted to the quiz's rendered
293:      height by variant-quiz.js, and this box never scrolls — when a viewport is
294:      too short the iframe itself scrolls (thin scrollbar, see the frame rule),
295:      so no scrollbar can ever run under the X. */
296:   overflow: hidden;
297:   border: 1px solid #474747;
298:   border-radius: 40px;
299:   background: #000;
300:   padding: 40px;
301:   /* room for the absolutely-positioned close button so it never overlaps the
302:      quiz title's first line */
303:   box-sizing: border-box;
304: }
305: 
306: /* Visually hidden title: the visible one lives inside the quiz iframe; this
307:    keeps aria-labelledby resolvable in the parent document. */
308: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-title-vh {
309:   position: absolute !important;
310:   width: 1px !important;
311:   height: 1px !important;
312:   margin: 0 !important;
313:   padding: 0 !important;
314:   overflow: hidden !important;
315:   clip: rect(0 0 0 0) !important;
316:   clip-path: inset(50%) !important;
317:   white-space: nowrap !important;
318:   border: 0 !important;
319: }
320: 
321: /* Height is fitted to the quiz content by variant-quiz.js (the quiz's React
322:    tree mounts asynchronously, so a static height is always wrong). The
323:    max-height keeps the frame inside the panel when the viewport is short:
324:    100vh − 48 (modal padding) − 80 (panel padding) − 2 (panel border). Past
325:    that the frame's own document scrolls with the thin scrollbar defined in
326:    variant-quiz-figma.css — 40px in from the panel edge, clear of the X. */
327: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-panel .mtd-quiz-frame {
328:   height: auto;
329:   min-height: 0;
330:   max-height: calc(100vh - 130px);
331:   border-radius: 0;
332:   background: #000;
333: }
334: 
335: /* The only close control: a bare 24 × 24 button pinned to the dialog's
336:    top-right, on the 48px padding grid (40 padding + 8). Not a score-button —
337:    the one-look-per-button-class rule does not apply to it. */
338: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-close {
339:   position: absolute;
340:   top: 48px;
341:   right: 48px;
342:   z-index: 2;
343:   display: flex;
344:   align-items: center;
345:   justify-content: center;
346:   width: 24px;
347:   height: 24px;
348:   /* the page-wide button rule sets min-width: 96px; the X is 24px */
349:   min-width: 0;
350:   min-height: 0;
351:   margin: 0;
352:   padding: 0;
353:   border: 0;
354:   border-radius: 0;
355:   background: transparent;
356:   color: transparent;
357:   font-size: 0;
358:   line-height: 0;
359:   cursor: pointer;
360: }
361: 
362: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-close svg {
363:   display: block;
364:   width: 24px;
365:   height: 24px;
366: }
367: 
368: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-close:hover svg,
369: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-close:focus-visible svg,
370: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-close:active svg {
371:   opacity: 0.85;
372: }
373: 
374: /* The vendor bundle styles every bare <button> (main.css `button:not(…)`):
375:    a ::after ripple that scales ×400 on :hover/:focus/:active and a filled
376:    :focus/:active background. The dialog focuses the X on open, so that
377:    ripple painted a green square behind the icon at every viewport. Kill the
378:    pseudo-element and keep the button's own box transparent in every state —
379:    keyboard focus keeps the page's standard plain outline ring (the
380:    body button:focus-visible rule in this file). */
381: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-close::before,
382: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-close::after {
383:   content: none;
384:   display: none;
385: }
386: 
387: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-close:focus,
388: .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a .mtd-quiz-modal-close:active {
389:   background: transparent;
390:   color: transparent;
391:   border: 0;
392:   outline: none;
393: }

396:   outline: 3px solid var(--sage-brilliant-green);
397:   outline-offset: 2px;

403:    Figma-exact 24/40 values above. */

## Objective
- Convert the MTD quiz from a modal/iframe layout to a full-screen page with standard scrolling, and apply original site interactive states to links, buttons, and option cards.

## Important Details
- Serve repo root via `python3 -m http.server 8150`; preview at `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Eliminate inner scroll container to prevent bottom "Before continuing" banner clipping at 1280x720 and 1024x540.
- Apply link states: default, hover, `focus-visible`, active (follow repo guideline).
- Apply button/card states: default, hover, pressed, focus (set once on shared classes only).
- Reference site for UI states: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Constraints: minimal changes, touch only related files, no debug code, do not commit.

## Work State
### Completed
- Initialized task tracking.
- Mapped `ongoing_project/MTD/` and `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/` directory structures.
### Active
- Reading source files (`variant-a/index.html`, `variant-b/index.html`, `quiz-page.css`, `quiz/` directory) to understand current modal, iframe, and layout structure.
### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Review remaining quiz assets (`variant-quiz-figma.css`, `quiz-frame.js`, `variant-quiz.js`, `quiz/index.html`) to identify modal constraints and target selectors.
2. Update CSS to remove fixed/modal positioning, enable standard page scroll, and implement requested interactive states for links, buttons, and option cards.
3. Verify fixes locally via the HTTP server and run core gates.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: Generated variant entry point for testing.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: Current quiz placement and modal styling.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: Figma-derived quiz styles.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz/`: Quiz iframe source directory.
- `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`: Reference site for interactive states.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

16:  *     mounts asynchronously, so a static height is always wrong), re-fitting

18:  *   - rewrite the progress fill as a % of the track (the bundle bakes a
19:  *     pixel width per step from the pre-restyle track);
20:  *   - swap the two Q1 card icons for the approved 60px light set;
21:  *   - hide the helper line and the support CTA, which Figma 3776:6405 does not

24:  * The registered mtd-income-tax page does not load this file.
25:  */

27:   var FRAMES = ["mtd-quiz-frame", "mtd-quiz-modal-frame"];

32:     if (frame.dataset.mtdAdvanced === "1") return true;
33:     var doc;
34:     try {
35:       doc = frame.contentDocument;
36:     } catch (error) {

41:     for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {

1: /* Keep the embedded quiz flush with its own content so the iframe never grows
2:    an inner scrollbar. Same-origin static hosting: read the document height and
3:    follow the quiz's own screen-change event. Under file:// the read is blocked
4:    by the browser's opaque origin; the CSS min-height then keeps the frame
5:    usable. */
6: (function () {
7:   var frame = document.getElementById("mtd-quiz-frame");
8:   if (!frame) return;
9:   var timer = 0;
10: 
11:   function fit() {
12:     try {
13:       var doc = frame.contentDocument;
14:       if (!doc || !doc.documentElement) return;
15:       var height = Math.max(
16:         doc.documentElement.scrollHeight,
17:         doc.body ? doc.body.scrollHeight : 0,
18:         640
19:       );
20:       if (height > 0) {
21:         var next = Math.ceil(height);
22:         if (Math.abs(frame.getBoundingClientRect().height - next) > 1) {
23:           frame.style.height = next + "px";
24:         }
25:       }
26:     } catch (error) {
27:       /* file:// opaque origin: leave the CSS min-height in place */
28:     }
29:   }
30: 
31:   function soon() {
32:     window.clearTimeout(timer);
33:     timer = window.setTimeout(fit, 50);
34:   }
35: 
36:   function watch() {
37:     fit();
38:     window.setTimeout(fit, 300);
39:     window.setTimeout(fit, 1200);
40:     try {
41:       var win = frame.contentWindow;
42:       var doc = frame.contentDocument;
43:       if (!win || !doc || win.__mtdHeightWatch) return;
44:       win.__mtdHeightWatch = true;
45:       win.addEventListener("mtd-quiz:event", soon);
46:       var observer = new MutationObserver(soon);
47:       observer.observe(doc.documentElement, {
48:         subtree: true,
49:         childList: true,
50:         attributes: true,
51:         characterData: true,
52:       });
53:       if (window.ResizeObserver) {
54:         new ResizeObserver(soon).observe(doc.body || doc.documentElement);
55:       }
56:     } catch (error) {
57:       /* file:// opaque origin */
58:     }
59:   }
60: 
61:   frame.addEventListener("load", watch);
62:   window.setInterval(fit, 250);
63:   window.addEventListener("resize", soon);
64: })();

2:    an inner scrollbar. Same-origin static hosting: read the document height and

4:    by the browser's opaque origin; the CSS min-height then keeps the frame
5:    usable. */

7:   var frame = document.getElementById("mtd-quiz-frame");
8:   if (!frame) return;
9:   var timer = 0;
10: 
11:   function fit() {
12:     try {
13:       var doc = frame.contentDocument;
14:       if (!doc || !doc.documentElement) return;
15:       var height = Math.max(
16:         doc.documentElement.scrollHeight,
17:         doc.body ? doc.body.scrollHeight : 0,
18:         640
19:       );
20:       if (height > 0) {
21:         var next = Math.ceil(height);
22:         if (Math.abs(frame.getBoundingClientRect().height - next) > 1) {
23:           frame.style.height = next + "px";
24:         }
25:       }
26:     } catch (error) {
27:       /* file:// opaque origin: leave the CSS min-height in place */
28:     }
29:   }
30: 
31:   function soon() {
32:     window.clearTimeout(timer);
33:     timer = window.setTimeout(fit, 50);
34:   }

37:     fit();
38:     window.setTimeout(fit, 300);

44:       win.__mtdHeightWatch = true;
45:       win.addEventListener("mtd-quiz:event", soon);
46:       var observer = new MutationObserver(soon);
47:       observer.observe(doc.documentElement, {
48:         subtree: true,
49:         childList: true,
50:         attributes: true,
51:         characterData: true,
52:       });
53:       if (window.ResizeObserver) {
54:         new ResizeObserver(soon).observe(doc.body || doc.documentElement);
55:       }
56:     } catch (error) {
57:       /* file:// opaque origin */
58:     }
59:   }

## Objective
- Convert MTD quiz from modal/iframe layout to a full-screen page with standard scrolling, and apply original site interactive states to links, buttons, and option cards.

## Important Details
- Serve repo root via `python3 -m http.server 8150`; preview at `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Reference UI states source: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Variants generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`; never edit generated `variant-a/` or `variant-b/` HTML directly.
- `quiz-frame.js` calculates iframe height via `scrollHeight` + `MutationObserver`; relies on CSS `min-height` fallback.
- `variant-quiz.js` auto-advances the quiz entry card and injects `variant-quiz-figma.css` for Variant A.
- Constraints: eliminate inner scroll containers to prevent bottom banner clipping at 1280x720/1024x540; apply states once on shared classes; minimal changes; no debug code; do not commit.
- Workflow governed by `skills/ROUTE.md` (one winner, specific open/leave-closed rules, skill module routing).

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped directory structures, variant generation flow, and skill routing rules.
- Reviewed `quiz-page.css`, `variant-quiz-figma.css`, `variant-quiz.js`, `quiz-frame.js`, and `variant-a/index.html`.
- Fetched reference site HTML to extract baseline interactive states.
- Verified clean git working tree (`HEAD detached at seed-quiz`, last commit `affe2e28`).

### Active
- Analyzing CSS selectors, iframe height clamping logic, and reference site styles to prepare full-screen scroll layout and interactive state overrides.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css` to remove fixed/modal positioning, iframe height clamping, and inner scroll constraints.
2. Implement shared interactive states (default, hover, active, `focus-visible`) for links, buttons, and option cards.
3. Verify full-screen scroll layout and interactive states locally at `localhost:8150/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: Primary target for scroll layout fixes and interactive state definitions.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: Generated variant entry point for local preview/testing.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`: Quiz advancement and iframe style injection logic.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: Variant A specific styling, fonts, and scrollbar overrides.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js`: Iframe height fitting utility and mutation observer setup.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`: Variant generation script.
- `skills/ROUTE.md`: Task routing and skill execution constraints.
- `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`: Source reference for interactive UI states.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

Product UI as HTML whose SVG 403s: the shipped `@2x` raster is then the measure source, and its edges are a downscale blend — size type off the measured cap height, never an assumed em ratio (0.72 read the whole small-text ramp a size small), and report the interior agreement rather than chasing its outermost 1px.

Product UI as HTML from a supplied screenshot: the bitmap's black or grey matte is capture surface, not product UI — take the art bounds from the window edges, derive the floor from the narrowest label's ink run and its browser width at 1px (a 2× cap-height read includes descenders and sizes the whole ramp too large), and put the page's backdrop behind the windows rather than repainting the matte. At the smallest rung the rows must feed ONE grid (a per-row `max-content` label track steps every value sideways), the divider belongs to the fieldset's right edge rather than the window's, and the 360 floor's body air leaves at ≤375 — otherwise the scroller engages at 360 itself. A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung. A balance row keeps the source's shape — label on the left, both numbers beside it on the `Balance:` line — because putting the label above its numbers wraps a value the source never wraps.

A product-UI variant of a shipped art (a second composition, a 10px floor, a scale) is the frame's arithmetic, and a screenshot cannot show it: run `node tooling/floor-check.js` — canvas 500, smallest type, one card gutter, the table's seat on its footer, the chart's clearance, the composition, at 29 widths in both switch states. A chart whose height is paid twice breaks the frame first: the 1.2× pie that fitted one aged card was a 508 canvas once the two were stacked, and a 137 donut was a 533 canvas at every width past 730 while every gate the page had still passed (2026-10-17).

Product UI as HTML, ruled cuts: scope cuts by media × container (`@media (max-width: 1079px) { @container (max-width: 559px) { … } }`) — a slot-width-only cut list fires on 1180–1420 laptop slots and hides card titles on desktops; pin the ruled height in the media block, never inside the pane's own `@container` (dead CSS — computed `0px` everywhere), and gate `scrollWidth == clientWidth` at phone widths (an art with a nowrap title needs `container-type: inline-size` to follow its slot; `min-width: 0` does not lower an intrinsic contribution).

Product UI as an animation: a piece that already exists as component HTML/CSS fills no raster slots — copy it verbatim and carry the page bundle's faces, line-height and box-sizing, or the art renders 7.4px short with fallback glyphs.

Page chrome: the same symptom on two pages, or a bug only on the deployed page, is not a folder edit. Run `node tooling/audit-live-comments.js` first. A missing column is a migration — sweep it per `docs/SUPABASE-APPLY.md`, and a re-run of one must be a no-op: a `create policy` without its own `drop policy if exists` aborts the whole Studio batch (42710) — `20261014130000` carried one until 2026-10-16. Paste-success is the editor's opinion; the deployed page's console going quiet is the after-apply proof, and it is scripted now: `node tooling/verify-live-doors.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-responsive.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-cpp-paths.js`, plus the write path's `node tooling/verify-write-roundtrip.js` (refused → stamped → resolved → deleted, nothing left behind). A live gate aimed at the page the change did not touch is not evidence about the page that shipped: `verify-live-responsive.js` opened only the unchanged vendor page and passed 12/12 while customer-payment-services scrolled sideways at 390px — it walks both CPP pages now, and a gated page hides its panes, so `render-check.js` strips the lock the way `check-tab-email.js` does. A migration cannot enable a dashboard hook: applying `15120000`'s function changes nothing until Authentication → Hooks → Before user created points at it — enable it (2026-10-16) and prove it with a real non-Sage sign-up, which must return `403` before any account exists (`node tooling/verify-signup-hook.js`). `node tooling/verify-page-comments.js` never loads `main.css`. A brand mark is already exported. Copy `icons/logos/sage.svg` onto the global bar and `icons/product-identifiers/sage-intacct--dark.svg` onto the dark sticky bar. Do not redraw either file.

The gate's viewing passcode and bot id are rows in `quick_signin_accounts`, never code: `resolve_pair()` is the one oracle the gate, `middleware.js` and the panel share, and the panel's Access section is the editor. A code changed in one place drifts the others. A tool the docs name is not evidence it runs: `add-pair.js` still rewrote a source array two weeks after the pairs moved into `quick_signin_accounts` (fixed 2026-10-16); it needs the service key and is the only thing that also moves the bot's auth password. A tool that measures the deployed page needs both doors: `audit-live-comments.js` carries the passcode cookie and a @sage.com stub session — without them it measures the sign-in shell and times out, which is exactly what the server door (2026-10-15) did to it for a day. A sweep must not reset a pair: the seeds insert only when the row is absent and self-test against the code the row holds — `do update set code` drove a rotated code back to the committed default on every re-run (fixed 2026-10-16).

A deployed old-tree folder URL 404s while its no-slash sibling redirects: trailing-slash normalisation runs before the redirect rules, so `:path*` never matches a URL that ends in a slash. The fix is the explicit rule pair plus the `middleware.js` backstop, not a wider wildcard. A case mismatch between macOS and Linux (e.g. Ongoing_project vs ongoing_project from .gitignore) 404s all child pages on Vercel: keep .gitignore rules lowercase and resolve casing dynamically in `middleware.js`.

A red `node tooling/build-node-index.js --check` is not cleared by regenerating. The parser reads the cpp block and the first table in `ongoing_project/cpp/MAP.md`.

## Objective
- Convert MTD quiz from modal/iframe layout to a full-screen page with standard scrolling.
- Apply original site interactive states to links, buttons, and option cards.

## Important Details
- Serve repo root via `python3 -m http.server 8150`; preview at `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Reference UI states source: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Variants generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`; never edit generated `variant-a/` or `variant-b/` HTML directly.
- `quiz-frame.js` calculates iframe height via `scrollHeight` + `MutationObserver`; relies on CSS `min-height` fallback.
- `variant-quiz.js` auto-advances the quiz entry card and injects `variant-quiz-figma.css` for Variant A.
- Constraints: eliminate inner scroll containers to prevent bottom banner clipping at 1280x720/1024x540; apply states on shared classes; minimal changes; no debug code; do not commit.
- Workflow governed by `skills/ROUTE.md` (one winner, specific open/leave-closed rules, skill module routing).
- Git HEAD at `affe2e28` (`WIP quiz-figma: fluid Variant A modal...`).

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped directory structures, variant generation flow, and skill routing rules.
- Read and established baseline for `quiz-page.css`, `variant-quiz-figma.css`, `variant-quiz.js`, `quiz-frame.js`, `build-variants.js`, and `variant-a/index.html`.
- Verified clean git working tree.
- Fetched reference site HTML to extract baseline interactive states.

### Active
- Preparing CSS modifications to remove fixed/modal positioning, iframe height clamping, and inner scroll constraints.
- Defining shared interactive state overrides (default, hover, active, `focus-visible`) for links, buttons, and option cards.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` to remove fixed/modal positioning, iframe height clamping, and inner scroll constraints.
2. Implement shared interactive states in `quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css`.
3. Verify full-screen scroll layout and interactive states locally at `localhost:8150/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.

## Objective
- Convert MTD quiz from modal/iframe layout to a full-screen page with standard scrolling.
- Apply original site interactive states to links, buttons, and option cards.

## Important Details
- Serve repo root via `python3 -m http.server 8150`; preview at `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.
- Reference UI states source: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.

- Convert the MTD quiz from a modal/iframe layout to a full-screen page with standard scrolling.
- Apply original site interactive states to links, buttons, and option cards.

- Serve repo root via `python3 -m http.server 8150`; preview at `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.

- Reference UI states source: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- `quiz-frame.js` calculates iframe height via `scrollHeight` + `MutationObserver`; relies on CSS `min-height` fallback.
- Skill rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): Implement rest, hover, focus, and active states together to prevent defects on other states.
- Constraints: eliminate inner scroll containers to prevent bottom banner clipping at 1280x720/1024x540; minimal changes; no debug code; do not commit.
- Git HEAD at `affe2e28`. Working tree is clean.

- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: Primary target for scroll layout fixes and interactive state definitions.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: Variant A specific styling, fonts, and scrollbar overrides.

part.text: I see you've shared two files. What would you like me to help you with?

## Objective
- Convert the MTD quiz from a modal/iframe layout with fixed positioning and inner scroll to a full-screen page with standard scrolling.
- Apply consistent interactive states (rest, hover, focus-visible, active) to all links, buttons, and option cards per project constraints.

## Important Details
- Preview target: `http://localhost:8150/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` (served via `python3 -m http.server 8150`).
- Never edit generated `variant-a/` or `variant-b/` HTML directly; variants are built by `build-variants.js`.
- Reference UI states source: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Constraint: eliminate inner scroll containers to prevent bottom banner clipping at 1280x720/1024x540 viewports.
- Skill rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): Implement rest, hover, focus, and active states together to prevent defects on unedited states.
- Git HEAD at `affe2e28`. Working tree is clean.

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped codebase, variant generation pipeline, and skill routing constraints.
- Read and analyzed `quiz-page.css`, `variant-quiz-figma.css`, `variant-quiz.js`, `quiz-frame.js`, and `variant-a/index.html`.
- Confirmed clean git tree at commit `affe2e28`.
- Identified modal/fixed positioning rules in `quiz-page.css` (`.mtd-quiz-modal` lines 72-137 with `position: fixed`, `inset: 0`, backdrop, and backdrop handling).
- Identified iframe height-clamping and inner-scroll constraints in CSS and JS (`min-height: 640px`, dynamic `scrollHeight` fitting).

### Active
- Preparing CSS modifications to strip modal/fixed positioning and iframe scroll clamping.
- Defining shared interactive state overrides (default, hover, active, `focus-visible`) for interactive elements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Edit `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` to remove `.mtd-quiz-modal` fixed positioning, backdrop, and height-clamped iframe rules, converting to a full-screen flowing layout.
2. Edit `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` to remove iframe inner-scroll constraints and inject consistent interactive states for option cards and buttons.
3. Verify the full-screen scroll layout and interactive states locally at `localhost:8150/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: Primary target for removing modal/fixed positioning and defining base interactive states.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: Variant A specific styling, fonts, and scrollbar/iframe override removal.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`: Handles quiz advancement, iframe style injection, progress bar updates, and height fitting.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js`: Iframe height fitting utility (`scrollHeight` + `MutationObserver` fallback).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: Generated variant entry point for local preview.
- `skills/shared/states.md`: Constraint documentation for interactive state implementation.
- `skills/ROUTE.md`: Task routing and skill execution constraints.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

15:       var height = Math.max(
16:         doc.documentElement.scrollHeight,
17:         doc.body ? doc.body.scrollHeight : 0,
18:         640
19:       );

21:         var next = Math.ceil(height);

## Objective
- Convert the MTD quiz from a modal/iframe layout with fixed positioning and inner scroll to a full-screen page with standard scrolling.
- Apply consistent interactive states (rest, hover, focus-visible, active) to all links, buttons, and option cards per project constraints.

## Important Details
- Preview target: `http://localhost:8150/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` (served via `python3 -m http.server 8150`).
- Never edit generated `variant-a/` or `variant-b/` HTML directly; variants are built by `build-variants.js`.
- Constraint: eliminate inner scroll containers to prevent bottom banner clipping at 1280x720/1024x540 viewports.
- Skill rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): Implement rest, hover, focus, and active states together.
- Git HEAD at `affe2e28`. Working tree is clean.
- Modal rules located in `quiz-page.css` (`.mtd-quiz-modal`, lines ~72-137 with `position: fixed`, `inset: 0`, backdrop).
- Iframe constraints in `variant-quiz-figma.css` and JS files (`min-height: 640px`, dynamic `scrollHeight` fitting).

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped codebase, variant generation pipeline, and skill routing constraints.
- Read and analyzed `quiz-page.css`, `variant-quiz-figma.css`, `variant-quiz.js`, `quiz-frame.js`, `variant-a/index.html`, `skills/shared/states.md`, and `skills/ROUTE.md`.
- Confirmed clean git tree at commit `affe2e28`.
- Identified modal/fixed positioning rules, backdrop handling, and iframe height-clamping/scroll constraints.

### Active
- Preparing CSS modifications to strip modal/fixed positioning and iframe scroll clamping.
- Defining shared interactive state overrides (default, hover, active, `focus-visible`) for interactive elements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Edit `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` to remove `.mtd-quiz-modal` fixed positioning, backdrop, and height-clamped iframe rules, converting to a full-screen flowing layout.
2. Edit `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` to remove iframe inner-scroll constraints and apply consistent interactive states for option cards and buttons.
3. Verify the full-screen scroll layout and interactive states locally at `localhost:8150/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: Primary target for removing modal/fixed positioning and defining base interactive states.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: Variant A specific styling, fonts, and scrollbar/iframe override removal.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`: Handles quiz advancement, iframe style injection, progress bar updates, and height fitting.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js`: Iframe height fitting utility (`scrollHeight` + `MutationObserver` fallback).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: Generated variant entry point for local preview.
- `skills/shared/states.md`: Constraint documentation for interactive state implementation.
- `skills/ROUTE.md`: Task routing and skill execution constraints.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

Product UI as HTML into a file path: measure the host ancestors' boxes before editing; a wrapper with `overflow:hidden` clips below content, and element screenshots never catch it.

Product UI as HTML from a node inside a component set: `figma-shot.js` cannot export there (the transport append is rejected) — measure live `get_design_context` geometry instead of the SVG pattern.

Product UI as HTML for a tab pane's picture: a raster pane inside a PNGs-only pattern takes live HTML only as a recorded deviation (the hero media-slot precedent — no SVG either way), and its 2x measure comes from `download_assets --defaultScale 2`; `get_screenshot` answers 1x for that vector node whatever `maxDimension` says, so sizing off it reads every small role a size short. A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

Product UI as HTML whose SVG 403s: the shipped `@2x` raster is then the measure source, and its edges are a downscale blend — size type off the measured cap height, never an assumed em ratio (0.72 read the whole small-text ramp a size small), and report the interior agreement rather than chasing its outermost 1px.

Product UI as HTML from a supplied screenshot: the bitmap's black or grey matte is capture surface, not product UI — take the art bounds from the window edges, derive the floor from the narrowest label's ink run and its browser width at 1px (a 2× cap-height read includes descenders and sizes the whole ramp too large), and put the page's backdrop behind the windows rather than repainting the matte. At the smallest rung the rows must feed ONE grid (a per-row `max-content` label track steps every value sideways), the divider belongs to the fieldset's right edge rather than the window's, and the 360 floor's body air leaves at ≤375 — otherwise the scroller engages at 360 itself. A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung. A balance row keeps the source's shape — label on the left, both numbers beside it on the `Balance:` line — because putting the label above its numbers wraps a value the source never wraps.

A product-UI variant of a shipped art (a second composition, a 10px floor, a scale) is the frame's arithmetic, and a screenshot cannot show it: run `node tooling/floor-check.js` — canvas 500, smallest type, one card gutter, the table's seat on its footer, the chart's clearance, the composition, at 29 widths in both switch states. A chart whose height is paid twice breaks the frame first: the 1.2× pie that fitted one aged card was a 508 canvas once the two were stacked, and a 137 donut was a 533 canvas at every width past 730 while every gate the page had still passed (2026-10-17).

Product UI as HTML, ruled cuts: scope cuts by media × container (`@media (max-width: 1079px) { @container (max-width: 559px) { … } }`) — a slot-width-only cut list fires on 1180–1420 laptop slots and hides card titles on desktops; pin the ruled height in the media block, never inside the pane's own `@container` (dead CSS — computed `0px` everywhere), and gate `scrollWidth == clientWidth` at phone widths (an art with a nowrap title needs `container-type: inline-size` to follow its slot; `min-width: 0` does not lower an intrinsic contribution).

Product UI as an animation: a piece that already exists as component HTML/CSS fills no raster slots — copy it verbatim and carry the page bundle's faces, line-height and box-sizing, or the art renders 7.4px short with fallback glyphs.

Page chrome: the same symptom on two pages, or a bug only on the deployed page, is not a folder edit. Run `node tooling/audit-live-comments.js` first. A missing column is a migration — sweep it per `docs/SUPABASE-APPLY.md`, and a re-run of one must be a no-op: a `create policy` without its own `drop policy if exists` aborts the whole Studio batch (42710) — `20261014130000` carried one until 2026-10-16. Paste-success is the editor's opinion; the deployed page's console going quiet is the after-apply proof, and it is scripted now: `node tooling/verify-live-doors.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-responsive.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-cpp-paths.js`, plus the write path's `node tooling/verify-write-roundtrip.js` (refused → stamped → resolved → deleted, nothing left behind). A live gate aimed at the page the change did not touch is not evidence about the page that shipped: `verify-live-responsive.js` opened only the unchanged vendor page and passed 12/12 while customer-payment-services scrolled sideways at 390px — it walks both CPP pages now, and a gated page hides its panes, so `render-check.js` strips the lock the way `check-tab-email.js` does. A migration cannot enable a dashboard hook: applying `15120000`'s function changes nothing until Authentication → Hooks → Before user created points at it — enable it (2026-10-16) and prove it with a real non-Sage sign-up, which must return `403` before any account exists (`node tooling/verify-signup-hook.js`). `node tooling/verify-page-comments.js` never loads `main.css`. A brand mark is already exported. Copy `icons/logos/sage.svg` onto the global bar and `icons/product-identifiers/sage-intacct--dark.svg` onto the dark sticky bar. Do not redraw either file.

The gate's viewing passcode and bot id are rows in `quick_signin_accounts`, never code: `resolve_pair()` is the one oracle the gate, `middleware.js` and the panel share, and the panel's Access section is the editor. A code changed in one place drifts the others. A tool the docs name is not evidence it runs: `add-pair.js` still rewrote a source array two weeks after the pairs moved into `quick_signin_accounts` (fixed 2026-10-16); it needs the service key and is the only thing that also moves the bot's auth password. A tool that measures the deployed page needs both doors: `audit-live-comments.js` carries the passcode cookie and a @sage.com stub session — without them it measures the sign-in shell and times out, which is exactly what the server door (2026-10-15) did to it for a day. A sweep must not reset a pair: the seeds insert only when the row is absent and self-test against the code the row holds — `do update set code` drove a rotated code back to the committed default on every re-run (fixed 2026-10-16).

A deployed old-tree folder URL 404s while its no-slash sibling redirects: trailing-slash normalisation runs before the redirect rules, so `:path*` never matches a URL that ends in a slash. The fix is the explicit rule pair plus the `middleware.js` backstop, not a wider wildcard. A case mismatch between macOS and Linux (e.g. Ongoing_project vs ongoing_project from .gitignore) 404s all child pages on Vercel: keep .gitignore rules lowercase and resolve casing dynamically in `middleware.js`.

## Objective
- Convert the MTD quiz from a modal/iframe layout to a full-screen page with standard scrolling.
- Apply consistent interactive states (rest, hover, focus-visible, active) to all links, buttons, and option cards.

## Important Details
- Preview target: `http://localhost:8150/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` (served via `python3 -m http.server 8150`).
- Never edit generated `variant-a/` or `variant-b/` HTML directly; variants are built by `build-variants.js`.
- Constraint: eliminate inner scroll containers to prevent bottom banner clipping at 1280x720/1024x540 viewports.
- Skill rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): Implement rest, hover, focus, and active states together.
- Git HEAD at `affe2e28`. Working tree is clean.
- Routing constraints verified via `skills/ROUTE.md`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Mapped codebase, variant generation pipeline, and skill routing constraints.
- Read and analyzed `quiz-page.css`, `variant-quiz-figma.css`, `variant-quiz.js`, `quiz-frame.js`, `variant-a/index.html`, `skills/shared/states.md`, and `skills/ROUTE.md`.
- Confirmed clean git tree at commit `affe2e28`.
- Identified modal/fixed positioning rules, backdrop handling, and iframe height-clamping/scroll constraints.

### Active
- Preparing CSS modifications to strip modal/fixed positioning and iframe scroll clamping.
- Defining shared interactive state overrides (default, hover, active, `focus-visible`) for interactive elements.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Edit `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` to remove `.mtd-quiz-modal` fixed positioning, backdrop, and height-clamped iframe rules, converting to a full-screen flowing layout.
2. Edit `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css` to remove iframe inner-scroll constraints and apply consistent interactive states for option cards and buttons.
3. Verify the full-screen scroll layout and interactive states locally at `localhost:8150/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: Primary target for removing modal/fixed positioning and defining base interactive states.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: Variant A specific styling, fonts, and scrollbar/iframe override removal.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`: Handles quiz advancement, iframe style injection, progress bar updates, and height fitting.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-frame.js`: Iframe height fitting utility (`scrollHeight` + `MutationObserver` fallback).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: Generated variant entry point for local preview.
- `skills/shared/states.md`: Constraint documentation for interactive state implementation.
- `skills/ROUTE.md`: Task routing and skill execution constraints.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.
